question: How does the three-aboded support of all also destroy the cycle of birth?
premises: The deity is the form of support
inference: The three-aboded supporting destroyer of birth is worthy of repeated obeisance.
uncertainties: adhāmarūpāya interpreted as form of support following legacy hint
plain_english: Repeated obeisance to the one of three abodes, the form of support, the destroyer of birth.
